user.title: Google Home Authentication
user.description:
Authenticate with the Google account that manages your speakers.

**Option 1: Google App Password (Easiest)**
Enter your Google Account Email and a 16-character App Password generated at [myaccount.google.com/apppasswords](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Leave Master Token, OAuth Token, and Android ID blank.

**Option 2: Browser Extension (Automated)**
Use the companion extension in `extensions/google_home_auth_extension`. In the extension popup, enter Flow ID `{flow_id}` and click 'Start Google Login'. It will complete this setup automatically.

**Option 3: Master Token**
Enter your Google Account Email and Master Token (`oauth2_rt_...` or `aas_et/...`).

*(Note: Standard Google passwords do not work on accounts with 2-Step Verification. Android ID is generated automatically if omitted.)*
